name: Halls of Nyarlathotep
detailed_description:
Step into the Dreamlands, a parallel realm accessible only through dreams—teeming with bizarre native beings and entities long lost to the depths of nightmare. In this Lovecraftian roguelite FPS, you must navigate procedurally generated labyrinths, confront eldritch creatures, and face the ancient Outer Gods that dwell in the deepest folds of the dream.

Nightmarish loop

You always craved more. Longed for greatness. For discoveries. Until you discovered something that no man should ever witness. A deal with the Crawling Chaos put you inside a never ending nightmare, forever cursing you to roam labyrinthian halls.

Mazes of insanity

Find your way through randomly generated mazes, filled with unspeakable horrors. Exposure to the unnatural corrodes your mind. The lower your sanity, the more the world twists—distorting perception, altering mechanics, and inviting madness. Be quick and do not get lost - each second spent in the labirynth lowers how much your brain can handle.

Every run reshuffles the mazes, from enemy placements to hidden chambers and forbidden relics.

Outer Gods

The Outer Gods are a central part of Halls of Nyarlathotep. Each biome features a unique entity that lurks in the space beyond the maze and culminates in a battle with one of the Dreamlands' resident deities - vast, unknowable beings whose presence alone is enough to shatter the mind.

Tools of the Occult

Arm yourself with weapons as strange and otherworldly as the realm itself. These are no ordinary tools of war - each one is steeped in occult lore or drawn from the fevered margins of Lovecraftian horror. Wield a revolver that fires tormented souls instead of bullets, swing a blood-hungry macuahuitl that grows stronger with each enemy it tastes, or brandish the Elder Sign to ward off the twisted things that should not be.

Alongside these relics, uncover ancient Sigils—arcane spells etched in madness—that can guide your way, shield your mind, or unleash devastating power upon the creatures that hunt you.

Locations from Dreamland cycle

Visit biomes inspired by works of H.P. Lovecraft, before he brought Cthulhu into the world. Travel icy plateau of Leng with its man-eating spiders and scale the mountain of Kadath where ancient gods dwell. Pray that cats from Ulthar will help you in your journey.

short_description: Explore the shifting labyrinths of the Dreamlands in this Lovecraftian roguelite FPS, where every shot, step, and secret chips away at your sanity as you face eldritch horrors and ancient Outer Gods.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 265
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-14400 or AMD Ryzen 5 7600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 or AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains Lovecraftian horror themes that can be intense and frightening. It features graphic violence including blood, gunfire, and the ability to shoot enemies’ heads off. There are no sexual acts or drug use depicted. The horror elements and violent content may not be suitable for all players.
